channel.title: Book Summaries: Sociology and Anthropology
channel.description: Discover comprehensive book summaries covering self-help, business, psychology, relationships, productivity, and classic novels. Get key insights and takeaways from bestselling books in minutes.

item.title: The Presentation of Self in Everyday Life by Erving Goffman
item.description: Goffman's account of social life as performance: how fronts, teams, backstage regions, and audience tact sustain the selves we present to others.

item.title: The Sociological Imagination by C. Wright Mills
item.description: Mills explains how biography and history meet, why private troubles can become public issues, and how social research can serve reason and freedom.
